extracted.intended_audience: individuals suffering from nervous disorders ('nerves'), their families and caregivers, and lay readers seeking dietary/exercise self‑help
extracted.subtask_short: diet and lifestyle for nervous people
extracted.subtask_description: Practical dietary and lifestyle rules for preventing and treating 'nerves' (nervous breakdowns), including what to eat, how to eat, exercise recommendations, and child‑rearing dietary guidance. Advice is aimed at lifelong habit change and relapse prevention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chew all food to a cream
rubrics_metrics.description: Chew every solid food until it becomes a cream before swallowing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeatedly emphasized as essential: increases brain and muscle strength, improves endurance, reduces gas, prevents poisoning from acid fruits, relieves constipation and helps apples work on the liver. Must be practiced permanently—not just temporarily—to maintain benefit. Anti-pattern: bolting food quickly (eating a big meal in fifteen minutes) undermines health and risks relapse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eat sparingly; avoid overeating
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not overeat; adopt a sparing, moderate intake of food.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Author: 'Always quit while you want a little more.' Moderation is presented as fundamental to preventing breakdowns. Overeating (e.g., gluttonous attitudes praised socially) is linked to poor health and later medical problems. This is a lifelong behavioural standard rather than a temporary diet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid tea and coffee; prefer plain hot water
rubrics_metrics.description: Nervous individuals should not drink tea or coffee; plain hot water is recommended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice: drink a cup of plain hot water after a meal and a cup half an hour before breakfast. The author notes he himself sometimes uses very weak tea, but the general rule for nervous people is to avoid both beverages. Anti-pattern: following physicians' casual endorsements of tea/coffee for nervous patients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not drink during meals; sip water between meals
rubrics_metrics.description: Refrain from drinking while eating; if drinking is needed, do it after the meal. Sip cold water between meals (about a pint daily).
